note: Outside references to lazy-chunk names that were reviewed as safe but that the scripts/split_app.js guard heuristic cannot prove (nested-block or early-return guards, a value passed along instead of called, chunk-to-chunk refs where the loader guarantees order, or a same-named local). Format "<chunk>:<name>"; every entry needs a reason. Re-review when the referencing code changes.

reasons.prospect:_jmClass: openPlayerCard JM tile: the call sits inside `if (!d._retired && window._pmBuiltData && window._jmClass) {` (nested block guard).
reasons.prospect:_pmBuiltData: card dynasty block: preceded by `if (!window._pmBuiltData) return '';` (early-return guard).
reasons.games:_gwGetPoolCurrent: cloud sync _restoreDaily: passed as a value; _verifyDailyTarget checks `typeof poolGetter === 'function'` and skips the legacy-doc restore when the pool isn't available (today's docs carry per-key dates and need no pool).
reasons.games:_gwGetPool2000s: same as games:_gwGetPoolCurrent (also wrapped by _pool150R, which checks typeof getter === 'function').
reasons.games:_gwGetPool2010s: same as games:_gwGetPoolCurrent (also wrapped by _pool150R, which checks typeof getter === 'function').
reasons.trade:_getTradeValue: only referenced from the myteams chunk (trade finder); the loader's PRE makes myteams load trade first, and PAGE_CHUNKS lists trade before myteams.
reasons.myteams:_mtLeague: badges team-graphics picker: inside `if (window._mtTeams && window._mtTeams.length) {` and itself `window._mtLeague && window._mtLeague.name`.
reasons.myteams:_udPortfolio: badges team-graphics picker: `(window._udPortfolio && window._udPortfolio.drafts) || {}` (left side of && is the guard).
reasons.myteams:checkPremiumStatus: the flagged lines call the auth module's own LOCAL checkPremiumStatus function (same name); My Teams only wraps window.checkPremiumStatus, which can happen whenever the chunk loads.
